title: frigate: pin joserfc at 1.1.0; ffmpeg flavor selection
reason: Applicable: real frigate module + wired test. Real diff adds a genuinely new ffmpeg.path mkOption (coercedTo package toString str, default pkgs.ffmpeg-headless), a top-level field distinct from the pre-existing per-camera ffmpeg.inputs.path.
targets_toml: single target frigate, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,frigate,ffmpeg], watch=[path].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEAR-TOTAL non-discovery: only 3 real options found in this large file, all under ffmpeg.inputs.* (a DIFFERENT, pre-existing nested path from the one this PR actually adds, services.frigate.ffmpeg.path). frigate.nix declares its own top-level options via `options.services.frigate = with types; {...}` (dotted-path plus an inline `with types;`) -- did not have time to fully isolate whether the near-total (not complete) blackout here is the same mechanism as headplane/bluesky-pds's complete blackout or a related-but-distinct partial case; flagging the raw asymmetry rather than asserting the cause.
